problems.title: Do these situations sound familiar?
problems.subtitle: As a company grows, it gets more data but less clarity. Here are the most common problems, what they lead to and how we solve them.

manualReports.title: Reports are compiled by hand
manualReports.problem: Reports are copied by hand from 1C, CRM and Excel. Often only one employee knows how to do it.
manualReports.consequence: Management sees the numbers late and copying introduces errors. When that employee goes on leave or quits, reporting stops.
manualReports.solution: We automate data collection from your systems. Reports update themselves, and your team works with the numbers instead of compiling them.

scatteredData.title: Every department has its own numbers
scatteredData.problem: Sales works in the CRM, accounting in 1C and the warehouse in Excel. The same metric comes out different everywhere.
scatteredData.consequence: Meetings turn into arguments about which number is right. Management stops trusting the data and decisions rely on gut feeling.
scatteredData.solution: We connect every source to a single data warehouse. Data keeps flowing into one place, and the whole company looks at the same numbers.

profitBlindness.title: It's unclear what actually makes a profit
profitBlindness.problem: Total sales are visible, but which product, branch, client or manager actually brings in profit is not.
profitBlindness.consequence: Money and time go into loss-making areas, while the most profitable clients and products get too little attention.
profitBlindness.solution: Margin analysis by product, branch, client and manager (ABC/XYZ). You see clearly where to invest and what to drop.

inventory.title: Overstock or stockouts
inventory.problem: Order quantities are set by experience and guesswork.
inventory.consequence: One product sits in the warehouse tying up cash, another runs out and the customer goes to a competitor.
inventory.solution: Demand forecasting based on sales history, a stock dashboard and alerts before an item runs out.

marketing.title: Advertising results aren't measured
marketing.problem: Money is spent on ads, but nobody knows which channel brings real sales.
marketing.consequence: The budget goes to channels that don't perform, and the cost of acquiring a customer keeps rising.
marketing.solution: We connect ad accounts, CRM and sales data. Cost per lead, sales and ROI for every channel in one report.

lateControl.title: Problems are spotted too late
lateControl.problem: Plan vs. actual is compared at the end of the month. To see where things stand today, you have to request a report and wait.
lateControl.consequence: Falling behind plan is discovered after the losses have happened, with no time left to fix it.
lateControl.solution: A KPI dashboard with plan vs. actual updated daily. If a metric drifts from the plan, the person in charge gets an email or Telegram alert.

industries.title: Solutions by industry
industries.subtitle: Every industry has its own data problems. Here are the most common ones and how we solve them:

fmcg.name: FMCG & retail
fmcg.title: FMCG and retail
fmcg.problem: Hundreds of products (SKUs) and several outlets, while sales and stock data sit in different systems.
fmcg.consequence: Best-sellers run out while slow movers sit in the warehouse. Nobody knows whether promotions actually paid off.
fmcg.solution: A sales, stock and margin dashboard by SKU and store, ABC/XYZ analysis and a promotion performance report.

distribution.name: Distribution
distribution.title: Distribution
distribution.problem: Data on sales reps, regions and clients is scattered across the ERP, Excel and reps' reports.
distribution.consequence: Receivables keep growing, and a region or rep missing the plan is spotted too late.
distribution.solution: A dashboard of plan vs. actual, receivables and payment discipline by region, rep and client, updated daily.

ecommerce.name: E-commerce
ecommerce.title: E-commerce and marketplaces
ecommerce.problem: Orders, ad spend and stock from your website, Uzum Market and other marketplaces live in separate accounts.
ecommerce.consequence: The real profit of each channel and product after commissions and ads is unknown, so the budget is split by guesswork.
ecommerce.solution: We bring all channels into one dashboard: orders, net margin, ad ROI and stock by product.

manufacturing.name: Manufacturing
manufacturing.title: Manufacturing
manufacturing.problem: Raw material, production and sales data sit in different departments, and unit costs are calculated by hand.
manufacturing.consequence: The real cost and profitability of products are unclear, and excess raw material ties up working capital.
manufacturing.solution: Cost and profitability analysis, plus dashboards tracking raw material use and production plan completion.

horeca.name: HoReCa
horeca.title: HoReCa: restaurants and cafés
horeca.problem: POS (iiko, R-Keeper, Poster), inventory and delivery service data are kept separately.
horeca.consequence: Food cost gets out of control, it's unclear which dish or branch makes money, and waste and shortages are found late.
horeca.solution: A dashboard of sales, food cost and average check by branch, dish and hour, plus menu engineering analysis.

logistics.name: Logistics
logistics.title: Logistics
logistics.problem: Trip, fuel, fleet and delivery data sit in different systems and spreadsheets.
logistics.consequence: The real cost of each trip and route is unknown, and delays and empty runs eat into profit.
logistics.solution: A dashboard of costs and on-time delivery by trip, route and vehicle.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.ctaText: We'll discuss everything in detail during the free audit.

q1.q: What do I get from the free data audit?
q1.a: We review your reporting processes and data sources (1C, CRM, Excel and others) and identify which numbers are missing for your decisions. You receive a list of problems and a plan to solve them. The audit is free and comes with no obligation.

q2.q: What is BI and why does my company need it?
q2.a: BI (Business Intelligence) turns a company's scattered data into clear dashboards. Sales, profit, inventory and other metrics are visible on one screen and updated every day. As a result, decisions rely on accurate numbers rather than guesswork.

q3.q: Do we need to replace our current software (1C, CRM, Excel)?
q3.a: No. We connect to your existing systems and pull data from them automatically. Your team keeps working as usual.

q4.q: Will the data keep updating after the project?
q4.a: Yes. We automate the data flow: new data from your systems arrives in a single warehouse on a schedule (for example, daily or hourly) and the dashboards update themselves. Nothing has to be uploaded by hand.

q5.q: Power BI or Metabase: which one suits us?
q5.a: Power BI is a powerful tool for complex analysis that works well with the Microsoft ecosystem, but it requires licences based on the number of users. Metabase is open source: it is installed on your own server and can be used without licence fees. During the audit we'll recommend the option that fits your needs and budget.

q6.q: When will we see the first dashboard?
q6.a: Usually within 2–⁠4 weeks we connect the data and deliver the first working dashboard. Then we add new metrics step by step.

q7.a: We sign a non-disclosure agreement (NDA) before work starts. We connect to your systems with read-only access. If needed, the warehouse and dashboards can be hosted on your own server.

q8.a: The price depends on the number of data sources, the scope of the dashboards and the level of automation. After the free audit we send a written proposal with the exact scope and price.
